qualifying_updates.factual_summary: The article argues that AI agents need first-class identities, named owners, purposes, permissions, lifecycle review or expiry, audit trails that preserve both human authorizer and executing agent, and visibility across SaaS, internal automation, development environments, and third-party integrations.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Use for local governance control implications; do not duplicate broad NIST or CSA entity background locally.
